sn35.230:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave bāḷisiko āmisagataṃ baḷisaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya
sn35.230:1.3: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave maccho gilabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa.
sn35.230:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave cha yime baḷisā lokasmiṃ anayāya sattānaṃ vadhāya pāṇīnaṃ.
sn35.230:2.3: santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.230:2.4: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.230:2.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu gilabaḷiso mārassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato …pe…
sn35.230:3.1: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.230:3.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
sn35.230:3.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu gilabaḷiso mārassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato.
sn35.230:4.1: santi bhikkhave cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.230:4.2: tañce bhikkhu na abhinandati na abhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu na gilabaḷiso mārassa abhedi baḷisaṃ paribhedi baḷisaṃ na anayaṃ āpanno na byasanaṃ āpanno na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato …pe…
sn35.230:5.2: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn35.230:5.3: tañce bhikkhu na abhinandati na abhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu na gilabaḷiso mārassa abhedi baḷisaṃ paribhedi baḷisaṃ na anayaṃ āpanno na byasanaṃ āpanno na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimatoti.
